sm_top.sm: Iranian forces targeted oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz with missiles and mines, causing fires and casualties.
Houthi missile and drone attacks struck Riyadh, damaging a skyscraper and prompting Saudi interceptions and airstrikes.
Poland accused Russia after missiles and a drone landed near a military exercise area.
Ukrainian strikes damaged the Crimean road bridge, halting traffic in an attack on the span.
The US reportedly deployed a third aircraft carrier to the Middle East to support ongoing operations.
Iranian missile/drone attack on Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait killed six US service members and injured eleven.
Russia launched massive missile and drone strikes targeting critical infrastructure and locations across Ukraine and Kyiv.
Myanmar officially rejected the International Court of Justice ruling that found it responsible for Rohingya genocide.
An oil tanker struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire.
Israeli ground forces conducted an incursion into central Gaza, crossing the 'Yellow Line' and causing widespread destruction.
A Russian ballistic missile attack damaged the Northern Bridge in Kyiv.
The Saudi-led coalition launched airstrikes on Hodeidah amid Houthi threats to Red Sea ports.
Iran attacked a US military radar system in Bahrain with drones.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi drone targeting southern Saudi Arabia.
Houthis advance toward Aden following the withdrawal of government forces from key Red Sea coastal positions.
Poland prevented a Russian false-flag operation at the border, according to an advisor to the defense minister.
Police/security operation in Port-au-Prince killed 34 suspected gang members.
Pakistan condemned a Houthi missile and drone attack on Riyadh.
The USS George Washington departed the Middle East after a three-month deployment.
Rocket attacks on Kryvyi Rih left two dead and dozens injured.
Iran reported shooting down another US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
The Israeli military targeted Hezbollah military assets and weapons shipments in eastern Lebanon.
Iran claimed to have shot down a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes across Yemen continue, with reports of at least 11 civilians killed.
RSF and allied forces advanced in Sudan's Blue Nile State, bringing fighting closer to Damazin.
The Yemeni army states 193 Houthis were neutralized across 854 military operations.
The Saudi-led coalition conducted airstrikes and destroyed ballistic missile launchers in Yemen amid a broader military operation.
Russian strikes and drone attacks on Odesa resulted in casualties and property damage.
Ukrainian forces liberated 14 settlements in the Kharkiv region.
Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge using its own weapons and communications technology.
Russian forces launched missile and drone attacks striking western Ukraine, including Ivano-Frankivsk and Lviv.
Houthi forces claimed missile and drone strikes on multiple sites in Saudi Arabia, including Jizan and King Khalid Air Base.
Russian air defenses intercepted and destroyed 275 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
Amnesty International reported that Rapid Support Forces drone strikes in El Obeid should be investigated as war crimes.
Iran conducted missile tests and launches from multiple provinces as part of ongoing military exercises.
President Zelenskyy announced that Ukrainian forces struck three Russian ballistic missile launchers overnight, destroying one.
Russian strikes targeted an energy facility in Odesa Oblast, leaving 41,000 households without power.
Air defenses intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh.
Israeli forces conducted renewed airstrikes on towns in southern Lebanon.
Russian MoD claimed strikes on Ukrainian energy and transport infrastructure, drone and uncrewed boat production sites, military airfields, and a high-level meeting.
